name: Hoodie Hero
about: The Stickman Explainer's own hero: a black stick figure in a blue hoodie, curious about how things work.
heightNote: the source skill gives no height: an everyday adult's

can.viewNotes: figure()'s face.look (0, 0.5, 1) and flip; back: face eyes and mouth "none"
can.faceNotes: the kit's own eyes (dot, wide, smug, happy, closed), brows and mouths (smile, smirk, grin, flat, o, chatter)
can.poseNotes: figure()'s pose: STAND, walk(phase), arm and leg angles, armIK; sit is the legs bent over a stool
can.talk: the mouth o and flat by turns (the kit's chatter for nerves); no lip sync

credit.author: Moworks Studio (the owner's Story source skill)
